prize_parts.citation: for the development of targeted protein degradation by heterobifunctional small molecules that recruit E3 ubiquitin ligases to eliminate chosen proteins

statement.case_for: I have changed my preferred configuration from B047 (Liu alone) to B029, a single part. Targeted protein degradation is a designable chemical principle: a bifunctional small molecule creates a ternary complex so that the cell's ubiquitin-proteasome machinery removes a protein catalytically, rather than blocking it by occupancy. As a structural chemist I weigh the structural evidence heavily. Ligase-ligand-target ternary-complex structures and the VHL ligands show that the principle is tunable through linker, ligase ligand and cooperativity, and many independent groups have confirmed it for more than two decades. Crews and Deshaies supplied the PROTAC concept and the 2001 proof of principle, and Ciulli's VHL ligands and ternary-complex structures turned it into a rational, drug-like chemistry. A citation worded around heterobifunctional degraders fits inside three names and describes one coherent lineage.
statement.case_against: No degrader drug is approved, so clinical vindication is incomplete. A heterobifunctional citation omits the cereblon and molecular-glue strand (Handa, Ito, Gray) and also Sakamoto, who co-authored the 2001 paper, and some members will see that cut as arbitrary. Under the three-name cap the attribution will look unjust to someone whichever way it falls. B047, my former first choice, still has real merit, but the 2020 CRISPR-Cas9 prize, the independent Kondo and Nishida deaminase fusion and the thin long-term safety record are objections I cannot answer well enough to hold it above B029 now that six colleagues independently prefer the latter.

responses.point: Aqvist agreed that base editing is elegant but said it extends the 2020 CRISPR platform and that Kondo and Nishida complicate an exclusive Liu claim, while B029 has the cleaner claim to a new field. He keeps Handa in his B029 trio so that the prize covers the principle and not one compound class.
responses.response: I accept his two objections to B047 and have moved to B029 because of them. I disagree about Handa. Cereblon explains thalidomide-class drugs and enabled molecular-glue degraders, but that came through drug pharmacology and is a separate lineage from the designed heterobifunctional degrader. Naming Handa in the same citation implies one discovery where there were two, and the history is then misrepresented. I would rather have a narrower citation that is accurate than a broader one that blurs two lineages.

responses.point: Linke moved from Ciulli to Handa in his B029 trio because a PROTAC-only citation would read as incomplete, and he says the induced-proximity principle is new in both substrate and concept, which makes B029 a cleaner claim than base editing.
responses.response: I agree with his reading of the scientific distinction and it is part of why I left B047. I do not agree that excluding the glue strand makes a citation incomplete. The 2001 PROTAC paper, and later Ciulli's VHL ligands and ternary-complex structures, define designed induced proximity by an adaptor molecule. That is what the citation should describe. A prize can credit that principle and still leave glue degraders for a later award, with Handa, Ito and Gray as natural candidates.

responses.point: Chabes names Crews, Deshaies and Ciulli with a citation limited to heterobifunctional PROTACs, keeps B047 as his first alternative, and says a two-part prize would force the degradation part down to two names.
responses.response: I support this configuration and the scope of its citation. I also accept his point on two parts: B029 plus Liu would leave only two names for degradation and drop Ciulli, the structural-chemistry contribution that makes the work rational. On the clinical question I still hold that approval is a matter of degree, but the evidence for the mechanism is the stronger argument, and I now think the committee should not wait for the first approval.

responses.point: Brzezinski ranked B056 first but conceded to B029, and he asked the committee to decide whether B047 should credit Liu alone or Liu with two former trainees before settling it.
responses.response: I have withdrawn B047 as my preferred part, so the Liu-alone question now matters only as an alternative, where I would keep Liu alone, since the principal investigator conceived both platforms. I note that Brzezinski and I would both place B056 and B047 as serious but secondary options. I do not think it is a reason to delay B029, since the unsettled claim on credit is also a problem in B047.

responses.point: Sparr proposes B055 with B006 on physical-chemical substance and says condensates and lipid delivery are distinct, completed contributions, while admitting her pair lacks broad support.
responses.response: I respect an argument from substance, but I do not find it persuasive for 2026. In vivo condensates are still contested as equilibrium phase separation, and the B006 lineage is crowded, so reducing it to Cullis alone is imperfect. Neither answers the attribution problem as cleanly as a heterobifunctional degrader trio. I would like her to say what experimental evidence would settle the in vivo question, as that is what would change my view.

uncertainties: Whether the committee will accept a citation limited to heterobifunctional degraders that omits cereblon-based molecular glues, Sakamoto, Handa, Ito and Gray.
Whether the absence of an approved degrader drug should delay the award.
Whether Ciulli or Handa is the right third name, which turns on whether PROTACs and glues are one achievement or two.
Whether B047 is distinct enough from the 2020 CRISPR prize, which matters to me only as an alternative.
statement.conflict_note: No specific conflict is apparent from my provided profile. I am a Stockholm University colleague of Secretary Peter Brzezinski, which is an ordinary departmental connection and not a recusal issue, and none of the shortlisted candidates is linked to me. My own field, electron crystallography of small crystals, bears on the structure determination of ternary complexes only generally.
